run_pyrobot_tests: run pytest with coverage for pyrobot test files and generate an HTML report
launch_gazebo_simulation: launch a Gazebo simulation via roslaunch with a specified robot base and wait time
exit_gazebo_simulation: terminate a running Gazebo process and run rosnode cleanup to shut down ROS nodes
generate_coverage_html: generate an HTML coverage report using the coverage tool and optionally open it in a browser
run_real_robot_tests: run a subset of pyrobot tests against a real robot instead of a Gazebo simulation
